History 2014-I.question: Which one of the following statements about Rig Veda is not correct?
options: Deities were worshipped through prayer and sacrificial rituals
The Gods are presented as powerful, who could be made to intervene in the world of men via the performance of sacrifices
The Gods were supposed to partake of the offerings as they were consumed by the fire
The sacrifices were performed in the temples
History 2014-I.answer: The sacrifices were performed in the temples
History 2014-I.explanation: (d)  The mode of worship was worship of the elements like fire and rivers, worship of heroic gods like Indra, chanting of hymns and performance of sacrifices. They were not associated with temples.

History 2014-I.subject: History
History 2014-I.question: Which among the following was the reason of the resignations of the Indian Ministers in all the provinces in the year 1939?
options: The Governors refused to act as constitutional heads
The Centre did not provide the required financial help to provinces
The Governor-General converted Indian administration from federal to unitary one because of the beginning of the World War II
India was declared a party to the World War II without the consent of the provincial government
History 2014-I.answer: India was declared a party to the World War II without the consent of the provincial government
History 2014-I.explanation: (d)  At the outbreak of the World War II, the Viceroy proclaimed India's involvement without prior consultations with the main political parties. When Congress demanded an immediate transfer of power in return for cooperation of the war efforts, the British government refused. As a result Congress resigned from power in all the provinces.
